name: Prism Gauge
title: Lux Unit Reference
description: A calibration character with Lux's 65-unit gameplay radius, 35-unit pathing radius, 330-unit/s walking speed, and published attack and spell ranges. The spells are range probes, not a reproduction of the kit.

q.name: Projectile Gauge
q.description: Fires a 140-unit-wide bolt at 1200 units/s, up to 1175 units. The bolt stops on its second target.

w.name: Return Gauge
w.description: Sends a 220-unit-wide marker to 1150 units and back. Uses a constant 2400 units/s rather than Lux's variable wand speed.

e.name: Circle Gauge
e.description: Marks a circle with a radius of 310, centered up to 1100 units away. The probe is instant.

r.name: Beam Gauge
r.description: Marks a 200-unit-wide line segment extending 3340 units from the caster.
